name: Push Relay
description: Forwards encrypted notifications from Astrodock servers to Apple (APNs) and Google (FCM).

env.description: Contents of the APNs .p8 auth key. Leave unset to turn iOS push off.
Key ID of the APNs .p8 key (10 characters)
The mobile app's bundle id, e.g. ai.astrodock.mobile
Firebase service account JSON. Leave unset to turn Android push off.
open: any server can register. code: registration needs RELAY_REGISTRATION_CODE.
Code a server must send to register when RELAY_REGISTRATION is code. Unset means registration is closed.
Host name or IP of the reverse proxy whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted for per-IP rate limits
